notes.title: The Chant Patch Notes
notes.content:
Our Dear Community,

We want to apologize once again for any technical issues you might have experienced with the Steam version of the DLC. The matter should now be resolved and you should be able to install it now. Thank you for your understanding and patience and enjoy the new content.

This week, we are not only releasing a new DLC for our players but also introducing a significant number of major improvements to the base game, enhancing the overall experience with more depth and diversity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433966/f20796c1e95cb547b1d0e757a02e8f90006d087e.jpg

You can find more details about the list of improvements below:

Revised Mind Body Spirit Experience System

Enemies are now classified as either Mind, Body, or Spirit
Mind, Body, or Spirit experience is gained from defeating each enemy type
Weapons and Abilities do extra damage if they match the same class of enemy
Enemies now have color-coded health meters based on experience type
Tuned overall mind body and spirit experience to make endings more equally distributedImproved AI

 Enemies are more observant and responsive
 Enemies can chase the player further
Combat Improvements

 More smooth and responsive auto targeting
 More accurate collision for player and enemy attacks
Visuals

 Gloom colors are more vibrant and clear
* Steam Only:

 Improvements to mitigate hitching on all quality presets 
Our team is always working hard to make the game better for you. We're stoked about this update and hope you'll have a blast with it!
Sincerely,
Brasstoken

notes.title: DLC The Gloom Below is OUT NOW! Redeem it for free!
notes.content:
Hey there,

We're excited to share that "The Gloom Below", the DLC for The Chant, is OUT NOW, and you can manually redeem it through the Steam store for free. This DLC continues the story after the events of The Chant, shedding light on Jess's journey and delving deeper into the history of Prismic Science.

In "The Gloom Below," you'll embark on a new adventure after escaping the eerie challenges of Glory Island. You'll venture into a surreal realm where The Gloom intertwines with the real world. Collaborating with the Anton Family and uncovering the stories of trapped cultists, players will face unexpected challenges while collecting unique items to combat The Gloom. If you haven't joined the spiritual session, now is the ideal moment to immerse yourself in The Gloom and explore a twisted world of cosmic horror.

[previewyoutube=KPrMI-hiouU;full][/previewyoutube]

The gameplay of The Gloom Below 

This expansion offers a challenging new structure that encourages replayability and experimentation to survive. Death provides its rewards as you return to the Nexus to upgrade your abilities and earn new weapons. Drain the energy from Monroe and his acolytes to unlock 18 new ability modifiers, enabling powerful combinations for damaging, evading threats, or immobilizing adversaries. Each creature you encounter presents distinct vulnerabilities that require creative exploitation.

New Content

This expansion enriches the lore, enhances your abilities, and introduces new weaponry, ingredients, and, of course, new enemies. The gameplay emphasizes action and combat, offering plenty of thrilling moments. With the Gloom eroding Jess' sanity, her mind and body are under constant threat. New entities lurk in the shadows, and brutal creatures relentlessly hunt you down. To survive, you must fight hard and think strategically, managing your inventory and adapting tactics. Bring down a host of teleporting Hyperleeches with the power of plasma as you charge up the iridescent blade to slice through the evasive Skulks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433966/f84110899aba9a0eb31d70c32ccc66706ef17bbc.gif

Main Game Improvements

But that's not all; with this release, we've included a list of significant improvements to the base game! We've revised the Mind Body Spirit experience system, enhanced AI and combat mechanics, and improved the visual experience by making the colors in The Gloom world more vibrant and distinct.

How to redeem your DLC version

To redeem your free DLC for The Chant, you need to own the base game. Then, you can redeem it on the DLC store page using the following link: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190430/The_Chant__The_Gloom_Below/

That is all for now, we hope you will enjoy your adventure in The Gloom! 

Sincerely,
Brass Token Team

notes.title: "The Gloom Below" - FREE DLC Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings to our community,


Did you miss the opportunity to join the spiritual retreat, or are you eagerly anticipating a return to the Gloom to unveil its secrets? We have thrilling news for you – the DLC "The Gloom Below" is on the horizon, shedding light on the story's continuation after the events of the Mind Ending in "The Chant." It's set to be released on 12 September.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433966/43f2e6f0728146b82d3b6d977806ec22414a3d98.gif

"The Gloom Below" takes players on the next leg of their adventure, following their escape from the horrors of Glory Island, deep into a surreal and twisted fusion of The Gloom and the physical world. Collaborating with the cursed Anton Family and following the stories of trapped cultists, players must fight their way through unpredictable encounters and gather the ingredients necessary to destroy the heart of The Gloom. 

The new content will add additional lore, upgraded abilities, new weapons and some new enemies too, as well as having significant focus on the combat and action elements of the game, giving users many more hours of horrific pleasure; each death leads players closer to their escape so finding the right build will be essential.

[previewyoutube=u9h8j_wSLnI;full][/previewyoutube]
But there's even more exciting news! The DLC will be FREE for everyone who owns the main game! For those who have yet to experience “The Chant” and to celebrate the release of the DLC, we are permanently reducing the price of the main game, so there is no better time to get into the cosmic horrors of Glory Island on 12 September.

notes.title: The Chant – Patch 1.4
notes.content:
Patch 1.4 is out now! 

We can’t believe it has been over a month since launch and we first want to take a moment to thank all our players. Your feedback is much appreciated and has served as a basis for the priorities addressed in today’s update and the hotfixes which preceded it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433966/e1694385f6b11bac26415cb3dfb6653d874c871e.png

New PC Features

 Added Key Remapping 
 Added FOV Slider
 Added more display FPS limiter options (72, 75, 90, 120, 165) 

All Platforms
Balancing & Tuning
Tutorial Tuning

Added and updated some tutorials based on player feedback
 Fixed the “Mind Attack Counter” tutorial not showing up as intended under certain circumstances
 Fixed the “Panic Mode” tutorial not showing up as intended under certain circumstances
 Fixed the “Gloom Sanctuary” tutorial not showing up as intended under certain circumstances
 Fixed the “Salt Can Interrupt Attacks” & “Desperate Dodge” tutorials activating incorrectly under certain circumstances
 Renamed and fixed a number of issues with the Gloom Vortex tutorials (formerly known as the Fast Travel Hub), not triggering as intended under certain circumstances
 Fixed the “Gloom Vortex” tutorial showing incorrect interaction prompts under certain circumstances

Angie Tuning

Angie encounter has been tuned based on player feedback
 Angie de-spawns for a longer duration when temporarily defeated
 Angie’s regular movement speed and hearing radius is reduced to encourage exploration

Chapter 6 Boss Tuning and Polish

Extensive changes have been made to this encounter to address player frustration and feedback
We’re aware there are still some balancing issues with this boss and we plan to release another hot fix patch as soon as possible to address these


Chapter 5 Boss Bug Fixes

Bug fixes & visual updates

Fire and Essential Oil tuning

Fire Oil - Self Damage radius is more forgiving
Fire Oil - Fixed damage direction from triggering the wrong hit reaction on the player when self-damaging

Bug Fixes & Misc

 Fixed Jess being hit into inaccessible gloom by enemies and not consistently bouncing off the barrier
 Fixed a potential blocker in Chapter 5’s irrigation puzzle
 Fixed players being able to input keystrokes/button presses while loading
 Fixed enemies getting stuck on Jess when going up a ladder, while in panic mode
 Fixed a checkpoint not saving progress as intended in the prologue
 Fixed an issue causing players to bypass the Mandacore encounter under certain circumstances
 Fixed spikes meant to block a door
 Fixed Crystalline Spikes being invisible on certain PC configurations
 Fixed default setting to be full screen instead of windowed mode
 Fixed default setting to be set to Custom scaling quality instead of Performance

Please continue to report any issues you may encounter while playing The Chant here in the Steam forums or our other channels across the social space.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433966/f8d84e2c91e4c23e58d1cade2c963a22539fcfa4.png

notes.title: Patch 1.3.2
notes.content:
Patch notes:


 Fixed issue in chapter 2 cannery fight that causes characters to get stuck after being smashed into a table.

 Fixed an issue during the reflector puzzle on the island in Chapter 4 where certain gloom areas became accessible without connecting the reflectors, which caused progression blockers if a checkpoint further along was triggered.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes:


 PSO Cache/Shader Pre-Caching added. This preloads matching quality preset compiled GPU shaders to improve performance and reduce any hitching when first playing through the game.

 Fixed windmill related progression issue if done in a particular sequence.

 Fixed mercury related progression issue if done in a very specific order/death sequence in Chapter 4.

 Fixed issue in the Inventory Research Tab, if the player is browsing through different items and leaves 
to either Upgrades or Inventory and returns back to Research, the layout is not reset and the columns will not be matching correctly.

 Fixed issue In the Options - Graphics menu, using "Apply" or "Reset Settings" will force players to the top of the menu.

 Fixed issue In the Options - Display menu, the "Reset Settings" is greyed out when Display Resolution is changed but not saved yet.

 Fixed issue in the Options - Controls menu, the "Reset Settings" is greyed out when Vibration Setting is changed but not saved yet.
